messages.subject: error in reference class
parts:
Dear Sqldf team,

We have recently identified an issue using the newest version of your package (downloaded about 10 days ago) with the R Reference classes.

We instantiated a reference class containing a global variable called "proteins" (type data.frame).

Our code gave an error on the following line:

dfcount = suppressWarnings(sqldf('select term_id, count(STRING_id) as proteins from ann group by term_id', stringsAsFactors=FALSE))

We noticed the error to be caused by our choice of the name "proteins" for the count. We could easily fix the issue just choosing another name.
Apparently there exists a conflict with the global variable in the reference class that has the same name (and this conflict happen only if such a global variable is NOT instantiated).

Thankyou for the attention.
Andrea Franceschini
